=='''Overview'''==
The '''Sunken Rod''' is a unique mid-game [[Fishing Rods|rod]] with moderate stats, obtained with a 1.6% or 1/62.5 chance from [[Treasure Chest|Treasure Chests]]. It is guaranteed to be obtained if the user have opened 50 or more chests, or opens their 50th chest. 

It functions as a greatly improved means of catching [[Treasure Map|Treasure Maps]]. For every 10 catches, the chances of catching a [[Treasure Map|Treasure map]] increases by 25%. This continues until the player catches one, then the chances are reset. After 230 catches, the chances for a treasure map to be caught are guaranteed.

It isn't particularly recommended for Fishing, rather it is best suited for accumulating [[Treasure Map|Treasure Maps]] to use for Treasure Hunting to collect loot. It does however, have better stats than the [[Mythical Rod]], and can be a decent mid game rod.

It also has a unique passive of having a 8% chance to apply the '''{{Mutation|Sunken}}''' [[mutation]], increasing the value of fish caught by 4.5x (450%).

=='''Enchanting'''==
The rod's best [[Enchantments|enchants]] are:
* For faster lure times to pair with the treasure map chance increasing passive, {{Enchantment|Swift}} or preferably '''{{Enchantment|Hasty}}'''. 
* You can also use a bait like [[Rapid Catcher]] or [[Instant Catcher]], and instead put '''[[Scavenger]]''' on the rod. 
Other alternatives are:
*For catching heavier fish, {{Enchantment|Unbreakable}}, or preferably {{Enchantment|Herculean}}.
**Note that '''{{Enchantment|Herculean}}''' is an [[Enchantments#Exalted Enchantments|exalted enchantment]], and will require {{Relic|Exalted Relics}}, which are better used on late-game [[Fishing Rods|rods]].
*For [[Fabulous Deity]]'s third and fourth quest, {{Enchantment|Invincible}} (Cosmic) is needed to catch [[Spectral Serpent]] and [[Scylla]], paired with an [[Exalted Relic|Exalted]] or [[Enchant Relic|Normal]] enchant relic. 
*
